axes.lifecycle: Controls generation, artifact selection, gallery, and release behavior: standard, optional, or exploration-only.
axes.maturity: Records whether a current design is accepted, accepted-experimental, prototype, or proposed without changing lifecycle by implication.

passes.statusReason: The complete-year 2025 source-separated particulate observation atlas is an accepted current visual and research experiment; it replaces the unqualified legacy artifact with an explicit evidence year.
claimBoundary: The pass maps dated observations and derived indicators; it does not perform event attribution or compute a composite severity score.
Source coverage, publication latency, and observational opportunity vary by layer and region.
Accepted-experimental status is not approval for navigation, engineering, causal inference, or unreviewed data refreshes.

passes.statusReason: The partial-year 2026 source-separated particulate observation atlas is the accepted current-year companion to the complete 2025 atlas, with its partial-year and incomplete FIRMS coverage retained.
claimBoundary: The pass maps dated observations and derived indicators; it does not perform event attribution or compute a composite severity score.
The 2026 product is explicitly partial-year and its NASA FIRMS contribution is absent until a keyed, reviewed refresh is promoted.
Source coverage, publication latency, and observational opportunity vary by layer and region.

passes.statusReason: The complete-year 2025 temperature field is accepted as the current experimental field treatment, including its source metadata, scale, title hierarchy, and transparency policy.
claimBoundary: The rendered field is a source-governed annual temperature product, not an event-attribution result.
Visual acceptance does not erase source uncertainty, grid scale, or temporal aggregation.
Accepted-experimental status does not promote downstream atoll or water-debris research prototypes.

passes.statusReason: The partial-year 2026 temperature field is accepted as the current experimental companion to the complete 2025 field, with partial-year status retained in every product.
claimBoundary: The 2026 product is explicitly partial-year and must not be compared as though it were a complete annual field.
The rendered field is not an event-attribution result and does not imply uniform observational certainty.
Accepted-experimental status is not permission to relabel, suppress the partial-year qualifier, or bypass source review.
